unauthenticated: Authentication is required. Sign in and send your access token.
token_invalid: The access token is not valid.
token_expired: The access token has expired. Refresh it or sign in again.
account_locked: This account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in :minutes minute(s).
invalid_refresh: The refresh token is invalid or has expired. Sign in again.
email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
password_weak: The password does not meet the requirements.
password_too_short: The password must be at least :min characters long.
password_too_long: The password must be at most :max characters long.
password_common: This password is too common. Choose a less predictable one.
password_contains_email: The password must not contain your email name.
password_repetitive: The password must contain more than two different characters.
password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
reset_invalid: The reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset_email_intro: Hello :name, we received a request to reset your password.
reset_email_link: Choose a new password (the link works for :minutes minutes)
reset_email_token: Use this code to choose a new password (it works for :minutes minutes):
reset_email_ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message. Your password stays the same.
cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
last_admin: This is the last active administrator. Another administrator is needed first.
role_name_invalid: A role name needs 2 to 64 letters, digits, '_' or '-', and must start with a letter.
role_exists: A role with this name already exists.
role_in_use: This role is still assigned to users.
registered: Account created. You can sign in now.
password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
reset_sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
password_reset: Password updated. Sign in with the new password.
